limitations: The locked project environment has no YAML parser dependency, so the loader intentionally supports and strictly validates the mappings, sequences, scalars, comments, and quoted values used by the committed market-lake YAML files rather than adding a dependency.
Key Vault references are preserved as masked SecretStr values; resolving a reference is the responsibility of the Azure-hosted runtime and is not performed locally.
